name: Rune
source:
[i]“If you want to change your fate, then I can help.”[/i]

[i]Beloved Pet on the Shores of Death[/i]

A mysterious boy who lives in Elysia, a world apart from our own. A self-professed witch, he gifts the heroine with the Fatal Rewind ability. This cheery, affable youth seems to be on the heroine's side, but he still has his secrets...

[From [url=https://products.voltage.co.jp/tempest/english/characters/?page=rune]Voltage Inc.[/url]]
